svg.title: Forty near-identical photos against forty varied photos
svg.desc: Two panels of forty thumbnails each. On the left every thumbnail is the same shot on the same background. On the right the forty thumbnails differ in background, angle and size. The right panel is marked this one wins.

g.text: Same effort. Same forty photos. Not the same model.
Thirty near-identical photos teach a machine about as much as one photo does.
